title: Fibre side: the Euclidean weighted area formula for Φ transported through the injective parametrization g (parent steps 3–4)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ; g : ℝ^n → ℝ^P continuous; A ⊆ ℝ^n Borel with g injective on A; F : ℝ^P → ℝ^n; Φ : ℝ^n → ℝ^n Lipschitz with F(g(a)) = Φ(a) for every a ∈ A; and h : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] Borel measurable. Then the fibre-sum function y ↦ Σ_{x ∈ g(A), F(x) = y} h(x) (the tsum over the subtype g(A) ∩ F^{−1}{y}) is a.e. measurable for Lebesgue measure L^n (volume) on ℝ^n, and ∫_{ℝ^n} Σ_{x ∈ g(A), F(x) = y} h(x) dL^n(y) = ∫_A |det DΦ(a)| · h(g(a)) dL^n(a), where DΦ(a) = fderiv ℝ Φ a regarded as a linear endomorphism of ℝ^n and the factor |det DΦ(a)| enters through ENNReal.ofReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (F : Euclid P → Euclid n) (Φ : Euclid n → Euclid n) (LΦ : NNReal) (h : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), Continuous g → MeasurableSet A → InjOn g A → LipschitzWith LΦ Φ → (∀ a ∈ A, F (g a) = Φ a) → Measurable h → AEMeasurable (fun y : Euclid n => ∑' x : ↥(g '' A ∩ F ⁻¹' {y}), h x) volume ∧ ∫⁻ y, (∑' x : ↥(g '' A ∩ F ⁻¹' {y}), h x) ∂volume = ∫⁻ a in A, ENNReal.ofReal |LinearMap.det (fderiv ℝ Φ a : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid n)| * h (g a) ∂volume
